DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. The DigiCert Platform team is the foundation everything else runs on. We build and own the DigiCert One platform that powers every other DigiCert product — the shared infrastructure, services, and identity layer that product teams across DigiCert depend on to ship. Most critically, we own IAM for the entire DigiCert product portfolio: every login, every session, every access decision across DigiCert ONE flows through our team.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Senior
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry\-specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems.  


  

Infor IQ is a component of Infor Data Fabric that builds an ontology over Infor’s CloudSuite ERP products, including entities, relationships, actions, business rules, and policies. This enables people and AI agents to query, reason over, and act on information with explainable and auditable results.  

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Design, build, and maintain the Infor IQ backend services \- the reasoning, query, and governance APIs that power the platform \- as Spring Boot microservices within the Data Fabric ecosystem.
  

* Translate product requirements and design inputs into technical specifications and implementation plans.
  

* Develop and extend the reasoning surface: REST and GraphQL APIs that classify, traverse, explain, and authorize against the ontology, returning explainable and auditable decision records.
  

* Build the ontology data layer over a federated SQL query engine (data\-lake tables via Athena/Trino) through an OBDA mapping layer, backed by tenant\-aware rule execution (e.g., Drools) over layered named graphs.
  

* Design and harden the grounding\-and\-governance boundary \- the platform authorizes and emits an auditable decision record but never runs side effects directly \- including SHACL/structural validation and the decision\-ledger audit pipeline.
  

* Review AI\-generated code for correctness, architecture, performance, security, and maintainability.
  

* Partner with product, domain experts, and the frontend team, using AI development tools such as Claude and Kiro as part of everyday development.

* Proven track record building and shipping pro

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization.  

  

IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.  

  

Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS\&T and delivers global\-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti\-abuse platforms \- covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2\.5 billion devices worldwide.
